Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is filed under Section 173 of t  Motor Vehicles Act 1988), to enhance the award in M.C.O.P.No.4595 o  2015 dated 21.03.2023 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Trib  (In the V Court of Small Causes), Chennai  For Appellant : Mr.K.Varadhakamaraj  For R1 : Dispensed with  For R2 : Mr,D.Baskaran  JUDGMENT This Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed to enhance the compensation award dated 21.03.2023 made in M.C.O.P.No.4595 of 2015 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (In the V Court of Small Causes, Chennai).
2. The appellant/claimant filed a claim petition under Section 166 of M.V. Act, claiming compensation of Rs.20,00,000/- for the injuries caused to Rama Chandran in the road accident on 16.03.20215.
During the pendency of the case, Ramachandran died and his legal heirs were impleaded as party.

sentences.text: 7. The learned counsel for the 2nd respondent submitted that the Tribunal taking into consideration all the relevant documents has rightly fixed the compensation, which does not require any interference.
Hence, he prayed for dismissal of this appeal.
8. In the instant case, the deceased was a qualified teacher and subsequently, the accident was happened and thereafter, 2 years later, he died.
Further, the Tribunal has not taken into consideration of the income.

Therefore, this Court is inclined to grant loss of income of Rs.20,000 x6= Rs.1,20,000/- and enhanced the amount of Medical Expenses of Rs.1,38,500/-, Nutrition Expenses of Rs.20,000/-, Attender Charges of Rs.10,000/- and Transport Expenses of Rs.15,000/-.

Therefore, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 22/08/2025 11:39:48 am )
Compensation award by the Tribunal is reworked as tabulated below:-
 Sl.

N Description Amount   o awarded by   Tribunal   
 1. Loss of income   (20,000x6) =
 Rs.1,20,000/-)
 2. Medical Expenses Rs.82,825/- 
 3. Nutrition Expenses Rs.8,000/- 
 4. Attender Charges Rs.3,600/- 
 5. Transport Expenses Rs.5,000/- 
 Total Rs.99,425/- 
9.

In the result, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is allowed in part and the compensation awarded by the Tribunal at Rs.99,425/- is hereby enhanced to Rs.3,03,500/- together with interest @ 7.5% per annum from the date of filing of claim petition till the date of deposit.

The 2 nd respondent is directed to deposit the entire award amount now determined by this Court along with interest, less the amount already deposited, if any, within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Judgment, to the credit of M.C.O.P.No.4595 of 2015 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (In the V Court of Small Causes, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
22/08/2025 11:39:48 am ) Chennai.

On such deposit, the appellants are permitted to withdraw the award amount now determined by this Court, along with interest, less the amount, if any, already withdrawn, as per the apportionment fixed by the Tribunal by making proper application before the Tribunal.
The other directions issued by the Tribunal with regard to the mode of payment of compensation remains unaltered.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
No costs.
